verdict.rationale: The Solo 2 'Hacker' edition ships with fully open-source firmware that users can build, flash, and customize themselves (own attestation keys, own firmware, full toolchain via Rust/cargo), which is the closest analogue to 'self-hosting' for a hardware security key — no cloud dependency by design. However, runtime evidence shows the surrounding tooling has bit-rotted (solo-python CLI fails on current fido2 libs) and no firmware release has shipped in 4 years, undermining confidence that self-building/self-hosting the core product is currently practical. Missing for 10: a working, up-to-date official build/flash pipeline, and independent confirmation that a user can successfully self-build current firmware today.
